title: Fast photochemical oxidation of nucleic acids maps protein- DNA interactions at sub-nucleotide resolution
authors: Marek Polák; Jiří Černý; Evgeniya Biryukova; Vítězslav Brinsa; Daniel Kavan; Michael Volný; Alan Kádek; Petr Novák
one_liner_zh: 该文开发FPON激光羟基自由基足迹法结合LC-MS，以亚核苷酸分辨率绘制FOXO4转录因子与DNA的互作图谱，并用分子动力学模拟验证，属于TF-DNA互作机制研究，但核心方法为实验技术而非AI/物理模拟创新，故评7分。
abstract: Transcription factor (TF) binding to DNA reshapes its backbone accessibility and modulate gene expression. However, protein–DNA interactions remain difficult to characterize with high resolution at the residue level. Here, we introduce Fast Photochemical Oxidation of Nucleic acids (FPON), a laser-driven hydroxyl-radical footprinting workflow coupled to liquid chromatography–high-resolution mass spectrometry (LC-MS) analysis. FPON quantitatively maps DNA accessibility and damage at sub-nucleotide resolution, revealing structural and interaction patterns induced by TF binding. Using the Forkhead box O4 DNA‑binding domain (FOXO4-DBD) bound to a double-stranded insulin response element (IRE), FPON generated structurally informative DNA fragments resolved and assigned by LC-MSn in a single experiment. Quantitative analysis identified site-specific protection patterns within the FOXO4 recognition motif. In the absence of a high-resolution structure, these site-specific protection patterns guided the construction of an in silico FOXO4–IRE complex. Complementary molecular dynamics simulations revealed a strong agreement between experimentally observed cleavage suppression and reduced solvent accessibility of DNA backbone hydrogens. Furthermore, FPON resolved multiple chemically distinct cleavage products otherwise indistinguishable in conventional gel-based footprinting approaches. Together, these results establish FPON as an unbiased, high-resolution strategy for mapping protein-DNA contacts readily applicable to more complex chromatin systems and dynamic transcriptional processes.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TF）与DNA的结合重塑其骨架可及性并调节基因表达。然而，蛋白质-DNA相互作用在残基水平上仍难以高分辨率表征。在此，我们引入核酸快速光化学氧化（FPON），这是一种激光驱动的羟基自由基足迹分析工作流程，与液相色谱-高分辨率质谱（LC-MS）分析联用。FPON以亚核苷酸分辨率定量绘制DNA可及性和损伤图谱，揭示由TF结合诱导的结构和相互作用模式。利用与双链胰岛素反应元件（IRE）结合的Forkhead box O4 DNA结合域（FOXO4-DBD），FPON在单次实验中生成结构信息丰富的DNA片段，并通过LC-MSn进行解析和归属。定量分析识别出FOXO4识别基序内的位点特异性保护模式。在缺乏高分辨率结构的情况下，这些位点特异性保护模式指导了FOXO4-IRE复合物的计算机模拟构建。互补的分子动力学模拟显示，实验观察到的切割抑制与DNA骨架氢的溶剂可及性降低之间存在强烈一致性。此外，FPON解析了多种化学性质不同的切割产物，而这些产物在传统的基于凝胶的足迹分析方法中无法区分。综上，这些结果确立了FPON作为一种无偏、高分辨率的蛋白质-DNA接触映射策略，可便捷应用于更复杂的染色质系统和动态转录过程。
